details:
This update for nodejs22 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-105481: Keep-alive socket process a response that was written before the request was sent (bsc#1286565).
- CVE-2026-105482: dns.resolve truncates names containing NUL char (bsc#1286561).
- CVE-2026-106069: TLS certificate hostname bypass when the host loosely resolves to an IP address (bsc#1286563).
- CVE-2026-106072: Improper certificate validation for non-canonical IPv4 hostnames allows DNS SANs to authenticate IP
  endpoints (bsc#1286566).
- CVE-2026-106073: Permission Model bypass with fs.realpathSync (bsc#1286570).
- CVE-2026-106074: crypto.randomUUID() and randomInt() entropy caches are saved into user-land startup snapshots and
  SEAs, so every process repeats the same values (bsc#1286567).
- CVE-2026-111497: Node.js Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write permits remote code execution (bsc#1286564).

Changes for nodejs22:

- Update to 22.23.4:
 - deps: update c-ares to 1.34.9
 - deps: update timezone to 2026e
 - deps: upgrade openssl sources to openssl-3.5.9
 - deps: update sqlite to 3.53.4
 - deps: update undici to 6.29.1
- Update to 22.23.3:
 - deps: update corepack to 0.36.0
 - deps: upgrade npm to 10.9.9
 - deps: update icu to 78.3
 - deps: update Undici to 6.28.1
 - node-api: support SharedArrayBuffer in napi_create_typedarray
 - node-api: add napi_create_external_sharedarraybuffer
